```{python}
#| label: imports
import os

import plotly.express as px
from itables import show
from IPython.display import Markdown, IFrame, display

from components.utils import get_mode, collect_jsons, collect_krona, get_settings_file
from components.tables import summary_table, version_table, settings_table
from components.plots import trimming_plot, filter_plot, cluster_plot, taxonomy_plot


DATA_PATH = "."


# Collect env vars
mode = get_mode() # Need ENV VAR `export REPORT_MODE=SINGLE|PE_OVER|PE_NON|ONT`
debug = True if os.getenv("REPORT_DEBUG", default=False) in ["True", "TRUE", True] else False

# collect files
json_files = collect_jsons(DATA_PATH, debug=debug)
```

# Summary

::: {.column-screen-inset-right}
```{python}
#| label: tbl-summary
s = summary_table(json_files, mode)
show(
    s,
    classes="display compact",
    scrollY="600px",
    scrollCollapse=True,
    paging=False,
    buttons=["copyHtml5", "csvHtml5", "excelHtml5"]
)
```
:::

::: {.column-screen-inset-right}

```{python}
IFrame(src=krona[0], width="100%", height="500px")
```
